MCMCModel class

Source: R/method_model.R
MCMCModel.Rd

This class represents a Bayesian borrowing model using MCMC sampling. It inherits from the Model class.

Super class

RBExT::Model -> MCMCModel

The lower bound of the credible interval

The MCMC configuration parameters
